name: retry-on-error
description: Resumes a session after a turn dies on a transient API error or a stalled API request: waits a few seconds, then submits a short continue prompt.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Global switch. Off: the mod never retries.

baseDelayMs.title: First delay (ms)
baseDelayMs.description: Wait before the first retry; each further retry doubles it.

rateLimitDelayMs.title: Rate-limit delay (ms)
rateLimitDelayMs.description: Minimum wait after a rate_limit error.

nudgeText.title: Nudge text
nudgeText.description: The prompt submitted on retry; <kind> is replaced with the error kind.
nudgeText.default: The previous turn ended on an API error (<kind>). Continue the task from where it stopped; re-check any step with side effects before repeating it.

retryMaxOutput.title: Retry max_output_tokens
retryMaxOutput.description: Also continue after a turn that hit the output token limit.

headless.title: Act in headless sessions
headless.description: Also retry in claude -p and SDK sessions.

notifyOnGiveUp.title: Notify on give-up
notifyOnGiveUp.description: Send a native notification when the retry budget runs out.

stallWatchdog.title: Stall watchdog
stallWatchdog.description: Abort and resume a model request whose stream has gone silent.

stallNoticeMs.title: Stall notice (ms)
stallNoticeMs.description: Silence before the status line says the API has stalled.

stallAbortMs.title: Stall abort (ms)
stallAbortMs.description: Silence before the stalled request is aborted and resumed.
